title: Method Section Output
description: Structured output schema for the method section content extraction. Typed unit arrays: contributions, components. Valid unit types: Contribution, Component.

anchor_id.description: ID of the unit that anchors this section; it must be defined in one typed unit array

contributions.description: Contribution units extracted for this section

id.description: Unit identifier in lowercase prefix:descriptor format

provenance.description: Location markers for this unit: top-level section anchors such as ['§1', '§2']

kind.description: What KIND of deliverable this contribution is: method (an algorithm/technique/architecture/model, or a proven formal result such as a theorem/lemma/bound — tag those with method_kind), dataset, benchmark, or finding (an empirical/analysis result — the deliverable of an analysis paper with no novel artifact)

method_kind.description: Optional finer structural classification on a kind=method contribution (algorithm/model_architecture/training_strategy/objective_function for an algorithmic method; theorem/lemma/bound/definition for a proven formal result; resource/taxonomy for a non-algorithmic deliverable); omit otherwise

description.description: Prose description of the contribution; empty string when unknown

inputs.description: Inputs to the method; omit when not stated or the contribution is not an algorithm

outputs.description: Outputs of the method; omit when not stated or the contribution is not an algorithm

name.description: Short label for the equation, e.g. 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention'; empty string when unnamed

expression.description: The equation itself, as LaTeX or plain text, e.g. 'softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d_k))V'

role.description: Functional tag: 'objective' marks the loss/optimization target the method minimizes/maximizes (at most one entry per distinct objective; a method with no stated objective tags nothing). Omit on ordinary defining equations.

description.description: One line on what the objective optimizes; only on a role='objective' entry — omit on all other formulas

formulas.description: Key defining equations, each with a short label; the entry tagged role='objective' is the optimization objective/loss; omit the field when the contribution states no equations

implementation_notes.description: Key implementation details; empty string when none are reported

components.description: Component units extracted for this section

id.description: Unit identifier in lowercase prefix:descriptor format

provenance.description: Location markers for this unit: top-level section anchors such as ['§1', '§2']

name.description: Name of the component (a sub-method/module that is part_of the contribution)

method_kind.description: Optional finer structural classification of the component (algorithm/model_architecture/training_strategy/objective_function); omit when unclear

description.description: Prose description of the component; empty string when unknown

inputs.description: Inputs to the component; omit when the paper does not state them

outputs.description: Outputs of the component; omit when the paper does not state them

name.description: Short label for the equation, e.g. 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention'; empty string when unnamed

expression.description: The equation itself, as LaTeX or plain text, e.g. 'softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d_k))V'

role.description: Functional tag: 'objective' marks the loss/optimization target the method minimizes/maximizes (at most one entry per distinct objective; a method with no stated objective tags nothing). Omit on ordinary defining equations.

description.description: One line on what the objective optimizes; only on a role='objective' entry — omit on all other formulas

formulas.description: Key defining equations of the component, each with a short label; the entry tagged role='objective' is the optimization objective/loss; omit the field when the component states no equations

implementation_notes.description: Key implementation details; empty string when none are reported
